item.text:
Implemented Task 003: projects can be archived and restored, lists can be filtered by archive state, and each project row shows its completion summary. Archived projects retain their tasks, show an “Archived project” notice, and prevent task creation or completion changes. The SQLite migration preserves existing project data.

Verified JavaScript syntax, `git diff --check`, and startup, health, and page-serving responses. The repository is clean.
